in_arabic.name: إمنون
in_arabic.meaning: إمنون اسم يعني من امن وطمأن
in_arabic.long_meaning: إمنون هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه من امن وطمأن، و هو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، و يعتبر من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبيرة في التراث الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: امنون
in_urdu.meaning: امنون کا مطلب ہے امن اور سکون
in_urdu.long_meaning: امنون ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے امن اور سکون۔ یہ نام قرآنی اصولوں سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی تقليد میں اس کی اہمیت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इम्नुन
in_hindi.meaning: इम्नुन का अर्थ है शांति और सुरक्षा
in_hindi.long_meaning: इम्नुन एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है शांति और सुरक्षा। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है और अक्सर शांति और स्थिरता के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: امنون
in_pashto.meaning: امنون د امن او ارام معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: امنون د عربي اصل يو نوم دی چې د امن او ارام معنی لري. دا نوم په اسلامي دود کې مهم دی او د سولې او ثبات د نښې په توګه کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Imenun
in_english.meaning: Imenun means peace and security or one who is secure
in_english.long_meaning: Imenun is an Arabic name derived from the root 'a-ma-na' which means to be secure or to have peace. It holds significant importance in Islamic tradition and is often associated with the qualities of peace, stability, and trust. The name has been used historically in various Muslim cultures and continues to be a popular choice for parents seeking a meaningful and spiritually significant name for their child.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Imenun" derived from the Arabic word for jasmine flower, holds cultural significance in various Islamic societies. Jasmine has long been considered a symbol of beauty, grace, and loveliness in Arab and Middle Eastern history. The sweet scent of the jasmine flower often adorns mosques and homes during special occasions, such as weddings, and is associated with peace, purity, and holy spaces.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the jasmine flower represents the concept of surrender (Ihsan) and proximity to God (Allah) proposed within the faith. The sweet fragrance of the flower is a reminder of the supplications and prayers offered to Allah in search of inner enlightenment, transcendence, and a closer connection to the divine. Imenun is thus a beautiful reminder that following the Islamic faith can bring growth, transformation, and a profound sense of spiritual connection, just as a jasmine flower continuously unfurls, offering the beauty of its scent to the world.
